name: Suspicious Caviar Blini
desc: Blini served with caviar. An unsteady hand has scattered most of the caviar everywhere, and what little roe manages to stay on the blini is neither plump nor fresh. One bite unleashes a stubborn fishy taste that lingers on the palate like some curse dredged up from the deep sea...

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 160 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
